# Notes API contract

The Zod schemas are the contract of the notes API. Requests that break them are
rejected before any handler runs, and the OpenAPI document generated from them is
what clients and the breaking-change check consume. These scenarios are the
acceptance criteria of the contract. Each one runs as a test.

## Requirements

| Requirement                   | Verified by                                                                                           |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="req-001"></a>`REQ-001` | [Default the page and page size of a list request](#default-the-page-and-page-size-of-a-list-request) |
| <a id="req-002"></a>`REQ-002` | [Reject a page size above the maximum](#reject-a-page-size-above-the-maximum)                         |
| <a id="req-003"></a>`REQ-003` | [Reject a field the contract does not define](#reject-a-field-the-contract-does-not-define)           |
| <a id="req-004"></a>`REQ-004` | [Version every route](#version-every-route)                                                           |

## Default the page and page size of a list request

Verifies [`REQ-001`](#req-001).

- **Given** a list request with no query parameters
- **When** the request is validated against ListNotesQuerySchema
- **Then** validation passes with page 1 and limit 20

## Reject a page size above the maximum

Verifies [`REQ-002`](#req-002).

- **Given** a list request with limit "500"
- **When** the request is validated against ListNotesQuerySchema
- **Then** validation fails on the "limit" field

## Reject a field the contract does not define

Verifies [`REQ-003`](#req-003).

- **Given** a create request with a title and an extra field "color"
- **When** the request is validated against CreateNoteRequestSchema
- **Then** validation fails because "color" is not a known field

## Version every route

Verifies [`REQ-004`](#req-004).

- **Given** the OpenAPI document for version "1.2.3"
- **Then** every path starts with "/v1/"
- **And** the document version is "1.2.3"

Every scenario on this page runs as a test in [`notes-contract.feature.test.ts`](../../../tests/features/notes-contract.feature.test.ts). The source is [`notes-contract.feature`](../../../features/notes-contract.feature).
